title: Cameras: camera lists, key-camera frames and daily videos

commands.name: rollup
commands.help: roll camera JPEGs into daily videos (the frame stream does this nightly)

storage: The largest plugin, on disk rather than in the database: the 34 key cameras download about 4 GB of JPEGs a day (2 days kept, about 8 GB) and the road-weather views about 2 GB a day (2 days kept), each rolled into one AV1 video per camera per day, kept (docs/11 §11.5).
ethics: The road network, not people: no plate or face recognition and no tracking of individuals. Images come only through 511 Idaho's republished copies (/map/Cctv/<id>), never from ACHD's image host or 511's list pages; they stay on the server and are never republished.
